# Sodales Receives Premium Certification as SAP Endorsed App and Announces New Application Name - Sodales Solutions

Toronto, ON – Sodales’ solution, Sodales for Enterprise Health, Safety and Employee Relations, has yet again been Premium Certified as an SAP Endorsed App, available for purchase on the SAP store.
SAP Endorsed Apps are premium certified by SAP with added security, in-depth testing, and measurements against benchmark results. Sodales is built on SAP Business Technology Platform and went through in-depth integration testing to receive the certification.
“We are delighted to continue our relationship with SAP through the Endorsed App program that demonstrates the immense value our solution has for SAP customers” said Sana Salam, Founder and President of Sodales Solutions. “This Premium Certification allows us to deliver a solution that helps transform customers’ visions for workplace health, safety, and employee relations”.While going through this recertification process, Sodales took the opportunity to rename their product to better reflect the singular platform. Sodales is thrilled to announce their new product name, Sodales for Enterprise Health, Safety and Employee Relations. The new product name will allow Sodales to ensure that health and safety management as well as employee relations processes are treated as an integral and connected part of their customers sustainability and performance.
Sodales would like to congratulate their entire team for their hard work and dedication to completing this premium certification process and looks forward to the many exciting things to come over the coming months with our new product name.
Sodales’ single platform approach allows organizations to connect health and safety, as well as risk and employee relations process with downstream business processes. With a single portal for managing health, safety and employee relations business processes for occupational and non-occupational incidents, disability claims, grievance management, disciplines, seniority, and job bidding processes, Sodales can help change your organizations culture from reactive “incident management” to proactive “incident prevention”.About Sodales Solutions
Founded in 2013, Sodales Solutions is an award-winning company, building solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform with pre-built functional, business, and industry content for regulatory compliance. Sodales cloud extensions fill critical requirements for highly regulated industries, including enterprise health and safety, leave management, labor relations, union job bidding, and seniority calculations. We strive to enhance collaboration within organizational groups – breaking down the barriers caused by silos and transforming compliance into a behaviour as opposed to a penalty. Sodales offers an SAP endorsed app, which is available on the SAP Store.SAP and other SAP products and services mentioned herein as well as their respective logos are trademarks or registered trademarks of SAP SE in Germany and other countries.
